title: Native Ringed Restriction Sheafification
statement: For a continuous and cocontinuous functor of sites, a commutative ring sheaf R, and a module presheaf P over its ring presheaf, direct restriction of the module sheafification of P is isomorphic to sheafification of the restricted module presheaf. Assume additive sheafification and its locally bijective criterion on both sites, with the common coefficient universe containing both site sizes. Dependencies: [lem-pur-native-ringed-restriction-hom], [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification].

source.place: Tags 0999, 099B and 0A0E; sites.tex Tags 03A0 and 03CH for equivalent sites and slices; sites-modules.tex Tags 03DA and 03DG for abelian module categories and intrinsic properties; sites-cohomology.tex Tags 08J7, 0A95 and 0941 for Hom and strict Roos comparisons. See the declaration docstrings for the particular step.

proof.text: the sheafification unit is locally bijective. Cocontinuity preserves this property after restriction, and continuity makes its target a sheaf. The universal property of module sheafification therefore identifies the restricted target with the sheafification of the restricted presheaf.

theorem sheafificationRestriction
    {C : Type c} {D : Type d} [Category.{vc} C] [Category.{vd} D]
    {K : GrothendieckTopology C} {J : GrothendieckTopology D}
    (F : C ⥤ D) [Functor.IsContinuous F K J] [F.IsCocontinuous K J]
    (R : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{max c d vc vd r})
    [HasSheafify J AddCommGrpCat.{max c d vc vd r}]
    [J.WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{max c d vc vd r}]
    [HasSheafify K AddCommGrpCat.{max c d vc vd r}]
    [K.WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{max c d vc vd r}]
    (P : PresheafOfModules.{max c d vc vd r}
      (NativeRings.{max c d vc vd r, d, vd} R).obj) :
    let T := restrictModules.{_, _, _, _, r} (K := K) F R
    let R' := NativeRings.{max c d vc vd r, c, vc}
      (restrictedCommRing.{_, _, _, _, r} (K := K) F R)
    Nonempty (T.obj ((PresheafOfModules.sheafification (𝟙 _)).obj P) ≅
      (PresheafOfModules.sheafification (𝟙 R'.obj)).obj
        ((PresheafOfModules.pushforward₀ F _).obj P))
